newsitem.title: USA: In Home Health cites trend for Q1 net drop.
newsitem.headline: In Home Health cites trend for Q1 net drop.

text.p: In Home Health Inc said Thursday a trend among Medicare beneficiaries selecting health care coverage through other avenues than its Visit division impacted revenue and net income in the first quarter.

The company, which provides health care services in client homes, reported revenue of $31.6 million, down from $32.5 million one year ago. Net income in the quarter totaled $14,000, versus $98,000 in the same period last year.
In Home Health said its Visit division also suffered from increased competition from hospital-based home care companies.

The company added that the loss applicable to common shares was $660,000, compared to $404,000 last year. The loss per common share was primarily the result of a preferred stock dividend paid to Manor Care Inc for a $20-million investment in the company in late 1995, In Home Health said.
In Home Health shares were trading down 3/32 at 2-1/32.
